fusions.name: Rearing Stamp
fusions.desc: Rears and stamps a gust outward, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking each back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Saddle Cast
fusions.desc: Looses a gust at a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 7 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach. Its damage rises 4% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 40%). Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Untiring Pace
fusions.desc: Restores 4 stamina a second for 6 seconds, and you move 15% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Long Rider's Lope
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 12%.
